desc:
🍎 SURVIVE THE ROTTEN FRUIT 🍎
One fruit goes rotten. Everyone it slices turns too. Last fresh fruit standing wins!
🪃 Throw your boomerang, bounce it off walls, catch it and throw again
🏃 Dash, jump and vault through Cannery Town to escape the Rot
🗡️ Got rotted? Grab the cleaver and hunt the survivors
🔥 Last fruit alive gets RAPID FIRE
🪙 Earn gold every match, open crates for fruits, hats, boomerangs and swords
🏆 Global leaderboards: Most Rots Sliced, Most Wins

👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite to support the game!
🎁 Join the community group for a free reward!
